comment: Reference settings for new play lots (docs/next/v3-synthese.md). Copy this file, rename the lot and change the seed: a lot name is never reused. Mix of v3g4-jouer-a plus two entries of v3-jouer-a lost on the way (3 neighbors, surplus on 8 slots). Kept: the C1 cleaning and the no_decision reject (C2), both built in; general diversity quotas; at most 2 grids per entry; at most 3 grids on 12 slots (size is what players call 'not compact'). Dropped: the per-type floors and ceilings, the single-decision and demand-price quotas (no visible effect on the stars, docs/next/v3-criteres-m24.md). Size caps of v3g6-compact to be added once S10.3 has judged them.
